steps.name: Just today
steps.objective: Go to [Rena Hiren] at the “Silver Shield Tavern”.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You arrived on time. Deliver His Majesty's edict.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Now, here. The seal will naturally disappear the moment you touch it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.
(As Lena said, the moment you touch the document, the seal melts and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It is one of the patented technologies of the Imperial Magic Agency. A seal created by entering the recipient’s information… . So it can only be released if the recipient is correct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you enter the information? I know who I am... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know the details of what the Magic Agency does. Now, let’s check His Majesty’s message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, let’s see… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “Dear messenger of the goddess. The power you and the goddess need is in Moros.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “If we find the ‘siblings’ who caused Freios and Eastland pain, we will get closer to the truth. 」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Don’t half-do this….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 「Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire – Kaina Dawn Sylvaria… .」

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (It’s been a while since I heard Your Majesty’s name...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, then what should I do now?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It is up to you to decide whether to follow His Majesty's will or not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a royal decree, but do you think you can defy it?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hehehe. Take care of that. For more information, go to the central guild city, 'Esnil', and meet President Dana.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It will tell you what to do. Then I'll just... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Lena... . It's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's the power you need... . I can't be the only one who knows this... . Hey, Iris… . Iris, are you listening? Iris, can I talk to you for a moment?
(Iris appears blurry in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes… , I am here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Iris the story you shared with Lena.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know for sure, but I feel a strong force there. I'm not sure if he's a superhuman or not, but I think there might be someone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you have no choice but to go and check for yourself... . There's something I want to know too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Okay, then… . Please.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please be careful. Then I… .
(Iris disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don’t worry…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I tried to tell you not to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. Let’s go first… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena said we can find out if we go to a person named Dana, so let's go inside.

steps.name: natural suspicion
steps.objective: Defeat [Retum] in “Warriors’ Rest” and obtain <Records of the Twisted One>. Then report to [Raclette] in “Esnir”.

lines.text: (The central street of the guild union city called Esnil. A woman with a luxurious elegance is standing in front of a tower that appears to be the guild union headquarters building.)
(The woman checks what appears to be a document and sighs.)
Phew, things got a little complicated while I was away for a while... . My sister again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you President Dana?
Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena sent me here.
Ah, it's you. I was waiting. I heard it from Lord Lena. I'm doing the work of a goddess. The name is %s… , right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My greeting was late. I'm Dana. The Guild Master is the 'General Manager' and the Storm Watcher, the general manager of the guild union.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you are from the Storm Watchers guild, Mr. Einst... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Thank you for taking care of everything Einst asked me to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, President.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It would be better if you called me by my name rather than the title of president. Because I don't like formalities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, President Dana... . No, Mr. Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay. I'll call you %s too. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I like it. Now let's get to the point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena said I could go to Dana... , what should I do next?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I received His Majesty's permission, and was given permission to enter Esnil... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like you're worried because you don't know what kind of person I am.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I first start doubting things I have no experience with. Otherwise, you won't know.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's natural, so don't be too disappointed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm always like that too. Actually, I don’t even know what kind of person Dana is. So what can we do so that we can trust each other?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe, thank you for speaking directly. Then, I guess I'll have to trust %s first.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Is this enough?
(Dana takes out a black card from her pocket.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All I have to do is sign this card, and Mr. %s authenticate the magic power with the help of the Infinite Corridor... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You will receive all the benefits of the empire, including the guild union city of Esnir.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You will definitely become someone recognized by Emperor Kaina of the Sylvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, show ‘us’ your skills. Because there is nothing more certain than showing your skills.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We… ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, us. ‘Moonlight’. You don't need to know the details, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I have something to entrust to Raclette. So come with us. Raclette will report to me what she saw there, so show your faith with that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it difficult?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If it's difficult, it's difficult, and if it's easy, it can be easy. Come on, raclette.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Relax your expression.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: President, I’m feeling quite comfortable right now… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Uh, sorry. It's an expression that I can't get used to no matter how many years I see it.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Then can I go there and get that item?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (object?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It might be difficult to do alone, so go with %s. Apparently, that is a place where the energy of the dead remains.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Let’s go, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where are we going?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: First, go to Mirgandia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all... ?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: You may know this place on a regular basis, but it will be different when you go there with me. Let's go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . First, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does it mean to say that it's a place you normally know, but it's different when you go there...?)

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. We just happened to get what we needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a place I've been to before... . Something was different today. It's like you've entered another space... .

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: You definitely felt it. It seems different because he is the one chosen by the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Of course, we are different from other people... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does it mean to be different?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: President Dana will tell you about that. Anyway, I finally felt the true power of God... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does this show you have faith?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: The skills were excellent. I will send you to the rector and he will take care of it.  Please bring me this book as you go... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Ah, this book… . That’s where you got it, right?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Yes, saved from the dead… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it wasn't available before, but why did it appear when I went there with Raclette?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Even in the same world, there are different sides, and we are lucky enough to see one of them and go inside... . Let’s just say it’s twisted.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: I'm trying to organize the backlog of logistics due to my trip. Go straight to the president. We will be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, of course. But what is this cake here? It looks delicious.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Zelic left the cake again, don't bother... . Oh, do you like desserts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I like anything delicious.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: That's good. Take everything here. Well then I'll just... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, there's Raclette. This is too much. Gone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, then let’s go to Mr. Dana.

steps.name: A new place of destiny (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Moss Kingdom Knight] and [Red Hildisvini] in "Moros". Then report to [Aurum] in “Moros”.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sure you didn't come empty-handed, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.  I found a book there and brought it with me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. This was what ‘we’ needed, but we had a hard time because it rarely showed up.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You showed up just then, and I was able to find it because of you. thank you so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This… , It wasn’t the guild union’s job, right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. So put your doubts aside for a moment. I'll explain everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By any chance, do you know what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What surrounds the world is not only light, but also darkness. The only thing people remember is the light, and they believe that light is the truth.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Both light and darkness are part of the world. In fact, every being has its own truth.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The darkness welcomes the light and embraces the ‘truth that gives rest to all.’ However, at some point the world became fearful and fearful of darkness.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Bad people took advantage of that darkness and eventually turned it into 'evil'. In fact, there is darkness that is not evil, but even that is denied... .
(A wave of darkness flows from the tips of Dana's fingers. The wave surrounds Dana, rises, and disappears after a moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, this is... ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe, let’s say it’s evidence of an unjust existence. Just show it to someone you can trust. You probably have one or two things you want to hide, right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Like memories... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know, Dana?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister just gave me a hint, and I guess she was right. I'm just guessing, so don't worry too much about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sister… ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We will meet that person when the time is right. By the way, weren’t you a little surprised when you saw our power? It's just a little twist, so don't be scared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't very surprised. There are so many things like this happening around me that I think it's just the way it is now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe, he's an interesting person. Now take this card. With this, you have become a more special person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dana. What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Now %s has somewhere to go.  I don't know if you know, but this is the Moros region of Eastland where the Allied forces are located.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moros region? Could it be that it has something to do with the Kingdom of Moss?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. If I explain it here, it might be a bit long. So, go there, get organized, and meet Saber.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then he will tell you the situation here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. But how do you get there?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If you go through the open air, you will see the Imperial Gate. It was created by the wizards of the Infinite Corridor under the royal name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, Mr. %s… . Have a nice trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The thing about going… , I'm telling you to come back when you're done there. Is that also your Majesty’s will?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Maybe so, right? Hehe, don't worry about that, just check what's in front of you. As you go, cut down any obstacles that get in your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s resolve the Moros issue first.)

steps.name: A new place of destiny (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Mos Kingdom Wizard] and [Tuxedo Schrödinger] in "Moros". Then report to [Aurum] in “Moros”.

lines.text: (In the distance, you can see Saber holding a strange weapon. Attacked enemies and suspicious creatures are lying around Saber.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it him? The Saber that Dana mentioned... . That's amazing. Dealing with so many enemies like that... .
Who is there?
Ah, I heard you %s..., Your Majesty. My name is Aurum, and as you can see, I am Saber.
(It is an outfit that has a different feel from the Holy Order of Platina. And you can feel the sacred energy from the weapon she is holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Aurum… . But looking at the weapon you're holding, I'm not sure if it's a saber. A club that feels sacred... ?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: As expected, you are different. Few people have felt the power of this blunt weapon... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Similar to the feel of lapier...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is similar to the energy of the land where Goddess Gaia stayed.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If so, I guess it was made from the sacred tree of that place. This is a weapon perfectly suited to me as I carry on my mission.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: After all, it's fun to blow away enemies far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, hey Aurum. I don't think it's time to be like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There seem to be a ton of enemies here, are you okay on your own?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You can do it on your own, but it seems like it will take a long time, so I'd like to ask you to do it. Give me a chance to fight alongside the Goddess's motherfucker.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can give you as many opportunities as you want, but please forget about that title. ha… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It’s a title I consider an honor… . Anyway... . You should also see Saber, a blunt weapon, recklessly running wild as Hwang Myeong-dong did.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'll do my best, so %s, please take over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Wait, what do you do? Are you going on a rampage?

steps.name: Etoile Allied Forces
steps.objective: Go to [Platina] in front of the “Magic Shelter” in “Moros.”

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. for a moment… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s felt the same way. evil power... . This must be… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stone… . If you feel this strongly, it means that there are not multiple magic stones... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If it's not a regular magic stone, it's probably theirs.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Aurum know them too?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes, I know. Ban and Mara… . And even the Kingdom of Mos, which the siblings empowered. The Allies are working hard, so it will end soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you explain the Allies?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana said she would talk to Saber when she met him.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh, you see. Then, we need to explain the Allied Forces.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: In the meantime, 'Sanctuary' paid attention to what was happening on various continents, including Freios.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Awakening a sleeping place, taking advantage of the greedy, using clans that lived in peace to attack other countries, etc... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: There were people who committed evil deeds. They called themselves Agashura, but they said something was different.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: His Imperial Majesty confirmed this and immediately ordered their extermination. But, it's not just about catching them... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: He sent envoys to gather various forces in order to erase the Kingdom of Mos that was with them from history.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: On the continent of Giendia, members of the ancient Empire of Giendia and the Kingdom of Elias, and on the continent of Freios, the Empire of Sylvaria and the Rivera Freedom Federation... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: In Eastland, the Kingdom of Jude and the Union of Light... . So many forces came together to subdue the Morse Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think with that level of power, they could even put an end to the Deimos Church.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'm not sure about that. The goal of the Allied Forces now is to end the Moros Kingdom here in Moros.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: First of all, members of various forces are dispatched to each district of Moros. I am carrying out the mission as I said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum's mission... , is it okay for me to know?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. His Majesty himself said that my mission is to run wild on the battlefield as usual.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have no idea what kind of person the emperor of the empire is...)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s I think you should go see junior Platinum now. My junior is chasing the power of the magic stone, but I don't think he can do it alone.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Your Majesty said the same thing. Platinum Junior needs %s... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it must be over there... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's a place called the Magical Shelter. Go in front of it. My junior is probably waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Aurum. Well then… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes, I will continue to defeat my enemies!
(No sooner has he finished speaking than Aurum runs into the midst of the enemies.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a great person. Anyway, I don't know when, but it looks like I'll be going to the sanctuary later... . How is Platinum doing? , let’s go quickly.

steps.name: dreaming greed
steps.objective: Defeat [Prince Nox] in the "Magic Shelter" and report to [Platina] in "Moros".

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hehe, is there any way to get in here?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (I feel a strong force coming from over there... I guess it's Senior Aurum or Adventurer...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Platinum, why are you here alone?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Adventurer, you are here. Since you've come this far, I guess you've met President Dana. I must have also met Aurum senior... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. After receiving His Majesty's royal decree... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Platina what happened in Esnil and the circumstances of meeting Aurum.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what's the situation here?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: As the Allied Forces took over the base of the Morse Kingdom, many villages and forces surrendered. The end of the Morse Kingdom is just around the corner.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: However, it seems like the greedy prince never gives up. He supplied magic stones to the knights and wizards who followed him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. Feeling the ominous power of the magic stone to this extent... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. There's a huge amount of magic stones in there. There, it's a place called the Magical Bomb Shelter.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Originally, it was like a safe area created by war-weary villagers to protect themselves, but now Prince Nox has led the remaining soldiers into it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're Prince Nox, are you the prince of the Morse Kingdom?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, I think he, the prince of the Kingdom of Mos, tried to use Ban and Mara to become the conqueror of the continent. But when things didn't go as planned, he forced his father, King Boyd, to step down.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The Allied forces captured King Boyd and forced Prince Nox to surrender, but the prince continued to hold out in the bomb shelter.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Then a wizard came out and killed King Void, and with a force different from before, defeated half of the Allied forces here.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It was the power of a magic stone. Their power to hold and use dozens or hundreds of them is truly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, that's a pain in the ass.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I heard that Adventurer defeated a man named Landain in Tartarus. Unlike Landain who was consumed by the magic stone, Prince Nox overcame it on his own.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: … If I could get in, I would fight him... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? Why can't Platinum get in?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The barrier is unfolding. Allied wizards joined forces, but we were not allowed.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Perhaps this is why His Majesty led %s. Adventurer, I would like to ask you to punish Prince Nox here.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: If you are Adventurer, you can go in and meet Prince Nox.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It would have been better if I had come here without hearing the story, but I feel uncomfortable for no reason.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking, Your Majesty? No, what kind of person are you? Suddenly I, and everyone here, feel like pieces on a chessboard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There’s no need for Platinum to feel sorry. This is it... . No, I would like to ask your Majesty someday when I see him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just as I have something I want to ask Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. If this is also planned, I will win. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: I personally sent elite knights and wizards, and you are such an amazing person that you can stand before me. I praise you. So, what is your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you want to know?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: That's rude. Who do you think I am? I am… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shut up, you're the one being rude. No matter who you are, it's true that you've done some harm to the world. Many people have shed blood because of you. know?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: This is for the greater good, and my will will be engraved beyond this land and on Freios. Because there is nothing we can do in this ominous land.

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: History will recognize those who do great things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you think the power you have is entirely yours? From birth to the status of a prince, to fake power using magic stones... . Don't be mistaken!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I praise you for not being consumed by the magic stone.

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Is it a compliment? Let me say thank you. And being encroached upon is only for the weak; it is a process I don't need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll make you regret those words. I don’t think they would think it was important if I mentioned the name anyway… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, then shall I make a promise? I'll let you know when I take you down. The bad prince here will just ignore it and say that won't happen, right?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: It's so shallow to see people say such obvious things so well. I am by no means weak. And he will do anything for the revival of the Morse Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, then let’s try it… ? It's something that was planned anyway, but I won't let you do whatever you want!!

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Ugh… .
(The magic stone with ominous power shatters and falls from Prince Nox's arms.)

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: I thought this magic stone would make my dream come true, but it wasn't... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This human, that human, why are they all so obsessed with this power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I destined to win anyway? If that's the case, why do we have to win so hard?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: … You know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know. I don't want to know, and I don't want to tell you, but I will tell you what I promised. My name is %s… .

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Cluck, cluck, cluck… . Yeah, that's a name I've heard of. The messenger of God who interrupted everything Van and Mara did and saved the Kingdom of Jude... .

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Why are you interfering with everything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A lot of strength goes into the hand holding the weapon. To the point where I want to hurt someone at any moment...)

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: To kill me... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will kill you... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. me… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no intention of killing you. I was planning on just taking it down and leaving it to the Allied Forces before heading back. Well, something is strange... ?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Hahahaha, cluck cluck… . You guys are like that too, ahahaha. Yes, to put it nicely, he is just a messenger from God, but he is a puppet anyway… . Cluck cluck… .

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: In this world, those who received the power of God and followed them committed suicide. You will too. The night of the witches will not remain still. And my will will remain like this, cursing you again and again... .

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Hahahaha... . Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk... . Kaaaaaaaa!! Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Huh?
(Prince Nox, looking angry, suddenly complains of pain and collapses. As a side effect of the magic stone, his arms and legs begin to turn into powder one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the end of this person? . uh… , Allied forces?
(Allied wizards rush in and use healing magic to prevent Prince Nox's disappearance. They then capture Prince Nox and drag him away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only defeated my enemy because I was destined to defeat him... . It's not refreshing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, let's go to Platinum first... .
(After the fierce battle with Prince Nox, someone slowly walks out from the back of the empty space.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Damn it, even Nox couldn't solve that guy. Is the Mosse Kingdom ruined like this? ?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Why are you so dazed?

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Oh, no. But do we have any magic stones left? If you have that, you can do anything.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: The device I installed a few days ago has been activated, so I just have to hang in there. Let's go there. To Oneiro… .

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: What about the guardian there?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: If everything went according to plan, it would have looked different now. And as soon as he gets in there, it's all over.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: After finishing our work here, let's go back to Freios. Go and wipe out the Sylvaria Empire again.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: I don't know. This is what we do with magic stones... .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Shut up. Think about the humiliation we suffered because of the Sylvarian Empire.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Follow me. Let's watch his life end there.

steps.name: scheduled day
steps.objective: Go to [Jin] in front of [Dreaming Oneiro] in “Moros”.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You are here. With this, the Morse Kingdom... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They said it was a space that only I could enter, but when did Allied soldiers come in?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: As Adventurer began to kill the wizards with magic stones, the barrier weakened, so I took advantage of the gap and got as close as possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were able to get there when Prince Nox's magic stone was broken.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Platinum knows what I should do now, right? I know you sent me here just to finish this job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not blaming Platinum, so just tell me where to go.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Sorry... .

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Adventurer must go to Oneiro Forest. The forest is located in the innermost part of the Moros region.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll know what to do when I get there.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes. If you go that way, Adventurer, someone you know will be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, so what happens to the war now?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: We captured all the remaining soldiers of the Morse Kingdom, including Prince Nox. Now, officially, the Kingdom of Morse no longer exists.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: From now on, the management of this Moros region will be handled by Jiscard, the leader of the Union of Light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's fast. For that to happen, I need to finish well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry for making you uncomfortable, Platinum. I'll go now. See you later then.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. Because I've always done well.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.

steps.name: What to do in the forest
steps.objective: Defeat [Bergelmir] in “Dreaming Oneiro” and obtain <Bergelmir’s Heart Fragment>. Then report to [Jin] in “Moros”.

lines.text: (As you go inside, you hear a familiar voice. It seems like you are confronting someone you recognize as your enemy.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Damn, I didn't think there would be anyone guarding Oneiro Forest... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: As expected, you guys caused the explosion.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Explosion?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Ho-oh, good. It's as planned. Now there... . No, rather, let’s deal with the warriors of the failed country first.
(Ban takes something out of his pocket and throws it at Jin. An unknown power flows from the thing that fell at Jin's feet.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Ugh, cluck cluck. What is this… ? This could not be… . You guys, what on earth are you doing... . My body doesn't move... .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: The disruptor dies here quietly. This magic stone is still in the testing stage, but as for you... .
(Jin struggles, but cannot move. The power flowing from the magic stone is slowly rising.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: This is... , bondage… .
(Van shows a satisfied expression and hurries into the Oneiro Forest with Mara.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I never thought it would end in vain like this... . I haven't even gotten revenge yet... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. Don't give up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Raise the weapon and destroy the binding force binding Jin.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Cluck cluck… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Phew… , thanks. Thank you for taking me out of this bondage. But how could you give me this power... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: (Ah, the strength is different from before...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power of bondage... . You know it too.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: We'll talk about that later. Rather, something dangerous is happening in the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is what I have to do. Please tell me quickly.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The name of this forest is Oneiro. This is a forest that the Mos Kingdom has restricted access to, saying it is ominous. It is said that there is a guardian spirit who will chase you away or scold you if you have bad intentions... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: My scouts and I went here several times, but we got lost and had to come back out.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Then there was a huge explosion... . Scouts were able to use the gap to check the place.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: They say the village and forest exploded, leaving strange traces, and the people turned into something terrible... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I tried to go back in and check, but I couldn't go in because of some force. I was dragged outside again.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Traces of the Mos Kingdom army and an unknown force were mixed together. So, I sent someone to the Allied Forces to check the situation... .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The culprit of the magic stone had arrived. Red-haired siblings... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The energy of the forest is definitely different from other places. It's like a curse... . I'll go. If I were you, I could go and fix things.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Why are you so sure?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't believe that much, you can't do anything.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Go and do what only you can do. I'm here to do my thing. I'm waiting.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Ah, when the situation there is over, please bring me an item that can help me understand the situation there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. And let’s talk about other things over a cup of tea after this is over.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Yeah... , wait… .
(I found Van and Mara hiding in the deepest part of Oneiro Forest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those damned bastards, I finally found them... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This terrible scene was all created by you, right? People trapped in a magic stone, a girl who has changed strangely... .

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: To some extent it is true, to some extent it is different. Well, one thing is for sure: you will regret coming here now.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: There is someone here who hates people like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?
(Something falls forward with a huge roar. A being so large that it feels like a huge shadow is covering the entire forest...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… . what? Golem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A suspicious monster made of stone, machinery, and plants...)
「Cheek… , Chiik… . Reboot… .」
「Activate… .」
“Code name Bergelmir… .」
(A voice that seems to have been created artificially echoes throughout the forest. It is probably the voice of that golem introduced as Bergelmir.)

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「Explosion mode opened.」

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「System access.」

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Preparing for initialization of Planet ‘Etoire’… . This course cannot be canceled arbitrarily without permission from the administrator... .」.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: What is reset?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: I don't know, it doesn't concern us anyway. Guardians cannot touch us or the magic stones we created. You saw it.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: He must be right because he said so. At least there has been no incorrect information so far.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: That's right, that guy... . Still, I have to do as he says... .
(Van and Mara are staring at where Bergelmir is.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are they… . Phew, I guess we just have to fight... ? Now, wait a minute, what… ?
(Suddenly, it feels like time has stopped. All movements, from Bergelmir in sight to Ban and Mara hiding in the distance, have stopped.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: … Adventurer, I’m glad I was able to see Bergelmir before the battle… . At least this is a part of the area I can access... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you do it?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It doesn't matter now... . First, a brief explanation… . Oneiro is another realm of time and space... . I was able to activate force for a moment… .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It was a weapon like Bergelmir that destroyed the world of another timeline... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Bergelmir's heart, if it is destroyed, it will not move... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you are curious about him, please destroy him and visit my room.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And please be careful... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Saraswati… .
(Saraswati's figure disappears and cannot be seen. As if time is moving again, Bergelmir's movements are captured again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is that the monster that created the bad ending? ?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Bergelmir begins initializing Planet ‘Etoire’. 」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say Bergelmir? Whatever it takes, I'm here to take you down. That's my goal now.

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Obstructor… . Interrupters are also included in initialization. I will assume you agree and proceed... . Kuoooooo!!”
(Bergelmir's heart cracks and stops moving. His eyes, which were obsessed with destruction, change little by little and even give a feeling of goodness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you finish it? ? Ah, if I say something like this, it happens again… .
(Bergelmir adjusts his posture and sits down. It is in contrast to his aggressive posture just moments ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still alive... .

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「… It’s okay to let your guard down. Guardian of this star... . Planet initialization was an error. The error was fixed through debugging.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's hard to say. You mean there will never be another fight?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「… That’s right.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can you believe that?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “I will stop operating soon. Before I do that, I need to tell you the truth.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you said that much, I will listen.

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「Thank you. tutelar. Then let’s talk. I am Bergelmir. A weapon dispatched to destroy this place where there are many evil beings.”

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「… However, Etoire is a good star. It's not evil. Bergelmir fought other evils that came to destroy this place. 」

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Then I fell into the forest and lost my memory. “It would have been better not to wake up.”

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「… “It was nice to meet the village people and meet Eda.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eda… ? That girl who walked around with strange monster arms on her back? The kid disappeared while attacking me, and as I followed him, I ended up here.

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「… The child is dead. As he disappeared, he thanked the Star Guardian. For helping Shinik and destroying Ixion... , for helping me escape from the curse... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik? Ixion? What do you mean? What is a curse?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Eda escaped the curse through death. However, he placed the same curse on them. To the humans who destroyed the daily life of this forest... .」

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Those humans also received that power from him, just like wizards. Eda was like that too. The curse of Eda has passed on to the humans in front of us.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So… . Are you saying that the curse is all the same curse, all the same power, something like that? what? this… .

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「… He calls this bondage... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, bondage… . The power of bondage?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “A huge energy stone was erected and exploded. Some lives, including people, were bailed out. That power was transferred to another space... .」

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「The misfortune here is for Azrael… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Azrael? What on earth is Azrael that kills living things?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 「Crackling… . Crackling... .」
(Bergelmir's voice is mixed with noise and cannot be heard properly.)

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: “Thank you. Guardian of the Star. and… .」
(Suddenly, Bergelmir stands up and pushes %s. An ominous force from somewhere pierces Bergelmir's heart and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... , this power… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fragments of Bergelmir’s destroyed heart tumble down at the feet of %s.)
(Bergelmir has stopped moving and is no longer moving.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel anxious. It’s the same feeling I felt once.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down, %s… . No need to think complicatedly... . I was just doing what I had to do here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talk to Jin and leave the rest to the Allied Forces... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Let's get out of here first. Don't say such useless things. Well, first of all, let’s take Bergelmir’s heart fragments… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Shh. quietly… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Oh, that… .
(A man in black armor and a man and woman with red hair can be seen in the distance.)
(It is unclear what the situation is, but the red-haired man is complaining of pain following the hand gestures of the man in armor.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Ugh… . Ugh… . Ugh, wow!!

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Stop it!! Let go of half!!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Argh!!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You said you would accept the consequences when the time comes. This is the result given to you... . This forest and that child should not have been touched.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: What do you mean? Ugh, stop. Well, I was wrong. So, please… . What did I do wrong to you? You delivered the improved magic stones!!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Wow!!

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: That, stop!! stop!!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The small vessel called you had to contain only a small amount of power. That's foolish. I should have finished it, but I couldn't stop... . It's your fault... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Now disappear… . Into the deep, deep abyss... .
(A huge hole suddenly appears behind Ban, who was complaining of pain. Dozens or hundreds of black arms appear inside the hole and surround Ban.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: That, stop!! My, I was wrong!! Save me!
(Ban's image becomes blurred and disappears like smoke. It's as if he has become a non-existent entity...)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Bar, half? half?!
(Mara, who witnessed the scene, collapses.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Deet, where are you… ? Bar, half… . Black... , black… . Black... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I know it's there, %s… . Come out now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Vice... Uh, but Jin?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jin, Jin… ? What are you doing now?
(Jin is putting strength on the hand holding the sword. It looks like he is going to rush towards Vice at any moment.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way, Jin. Stop.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Don't stop me. I, my country... . Because of the Deimos Church, Van and Mara, those guys... . Ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jin, don't stay here, join the Allied Forces. I'll do my best here. Trust me and go back. And take this. Evidence from Oneiro Forest… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Got it. Then please take care of it... .
(Jin nods and hurries towards the direction of the Allied Forces.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I have a story to tell. It has to be done behind the scenes, not here… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if? Now, wait… . Where the hell are you taking me?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is this place? I’m sure it’s Moros… .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Okay, I'll tell you. He returned as you saw, with strength to be used where needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Power to be used where needed? What on earth did you do with thousands and tens of thousands of lives? And what is Azrael?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: … You don't need to know that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth do you think life is?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I have something to give you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Get something from the enemy? Are you sane?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The power I gained while staying in Eastland... . Let's say it's a trace of the power of a superhuman.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Even without that, I have no problem. So I will give it to those who need it. Right to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't need your strength. All you need is something from another superhuman!! I know what kind of power you give me... .

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Weiss's snort brings out the anxiety and subtle feelings I felt in Coral City, Monster Tree Mountain, and Magic Academy Zerenis all at once.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Yes, this was something I, or he, had been planning for a long time. You foolishly doubted your God.
(Weiss raises his hand and shakes it slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange power comes from somewhere and entangles my entire body. The power I felt in Lapier, and the fear I felt at the magic academy not long ago...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: This power to bind you is entirely mine, but the power to give you is not mine. Now, I will be closer to the end, as I am, and you will be as you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argh!! Stop it!!
(As Weiss opens his hand, a strange orb of light rises within it. The orb of clear, beautiful purple light leaves his hand and heads toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The power of Vice is flowing and being absorbed into me.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But this... Shinik... a trace of the power of a superhuman given by Adkina... It feels the same as back then. Did this person get this power from here?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: After all, you know that this power is the same as theirs.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Yes, the gods who loved this world left their power in Eastland, and the remaining power reached those who transcended humans.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: … It's a shame to let you go like this, so I'll make you suffer a little more. In addition, I will tell you something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaa!! Ugh… . Well, what is that... . Wow!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As Weiss smiles in satisfaction, the pain continues to be felt as if it is imprinted throughout her body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, wow, wow!!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I will wait at the 'end' for you to reach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can’t hear what Vice is saying properly….)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: And you call him... … … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't hear Vice's voice... I can't even see her face...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Iris, sorry….)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Wake up, %s!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jin’s figure appears through blurred vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jin… , here… . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Suddenly, the pain of the force of the vice comes to mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cluck, cluck… . eww… . eww… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Priests over there, hurry over here!!
(Priests come running from somewhere at Jin's shout. The priests check the condition of the fallen %s and use recovery magic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why does this happen to me….)

steps.name: the end of a kingdom
steps.objective: After talking to [Jin] in front of [Dreaming Oneiro] in "Moros", go to [Dana] in '"Esnil".

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Thank goodness. There were no serious injuries... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, the work here is done... ?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The Moros' work is all done. The Allied Forces will take care of the rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you told anyone about seeing Vice here? Oh, that golem, what did you do with the heart fragment?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Phew, I really don't know who you are. You can figure that out later.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Yeah, I'll tell you. I didn't tell anyone about seeing Vice. No, I won't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I will keep the heart fragment and leave it to the Jewel School wizard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Also, the woman named Mara decided to be interrogated directly in the Sylvaria Empire. There are also preparations in Jude Kingdom, but that will come later.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Is there an answer now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I'm fine now. You don't need any more treatment.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: It seems to be okay, but don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I'm going to go back and rest.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I'll prepare a place for you at Luman. How about resting there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. If I go back, it will disturb Iris... . There is a place to go in Freios. I'll go there.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I don't know what's waiting for you, but I hope nothing bad happens.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: And later, when you have time, come visit Luman. Because I have a story to tell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It has definitely changed. My mind has become clearer due to the power I received from Weiss, so this is definitely a trace of the power of a superhuman...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I don't know. Let's go to Dana first... and let's not do anything for a while...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Good luck, Mr. %s… .
(Dana hugs him with a worried expression.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are you feeling okay? Are you hurt anywhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Dana briefly about what happened in Moros.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … thank god. I'll say it again, I'm glad... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew… . A guy called Unni contacted me after a long time and gave me this kind of thing. Create a bad role that has no choice but to send someone to a strict person or a dangerous place.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … Sorry, I'm just talking to myself, don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You say that out loud. By the way, where have you been? You have a wound... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: While %s was there, we had our own things to do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I found the group that came when I was weak and scolded them. Phew… . Anyway, you had a hard time. The high-ranking nobles of the empire will take care of all the troublesome matters for the time being, so take a break... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. This world is indebted to you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I am… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So please take care of me in the future as well. Because you might end up in debt again. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, sure. I'm getting frustrated again thinking that this won't be the end.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What should I do because I have more than one thing to be thankful for... . I realized too late that I helped my younger brother last time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your younger brother?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, about the Zerenis Magic Academy thing. The student council president there, Shiina, is my younger sister. Shiina Dawn Sylvaria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it looked somewhat similar. Wait, what? … Dun Sylvaria after the name? Where have I heard this before... . When receiving His Majesty's royal decree... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Huh? You came this far, didn’t you already know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really didn't know.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Wow, looking at the reaction, it looks like they really didn't know. Phew… . Hahaha, my real sister is… . Ugh, I don’t know… . First of all, %s, you look tired, so rest at the guild inn. Ahahahaha… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll send you a lot of food made by Zelic, so you can eat and rest. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. all right. Okay, we'll talk about it later.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, later… . I don't know when, but come back when you want to talk about anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'm going to the inn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Seeing Dana pushing her back makes me think I need to go quickly.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew, this is why I don’t want to get involved with my sister. Still, I can't help it. The reason I'm alive like this is because of my sister.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's that time... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Well, you've waited a long time.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Kazno Mr.
(From the dark shadows inside the city, a person named Kazno slowly walks forward.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I found the part of the snake that Mr. Jeril asked for. Jisk's estate in Eastland. That's right there.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I am indebted to you... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Well, you probably know anyway, so it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I will keep my promise.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for that. Anyway, I'm jealous. It's possible to use Agashura's contract as an excuse to make excuses... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Huh, it's already gone. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then I guess I should get some rest too. I don't know what else will happen, so I'm preparing... .
